description: Produce a dated, explicitly non-live Linear-to-Notion progress summary, or capture an outcome/learning after work completes.

evals.name: Summarize progress to Notion
evals.prompt: Summarize progress on the CSV export project to Notion.
evals.expected_output: Reads Linear facts, produces a summary explicitly dated and labeled as a snapshot (not live), and states approval is required before writing to Notion.

evals.name: Capture a learning
evals.prompt: Capture what we learned from shipping the CSV export feature.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes this from open-item disposition (correctly defers unresolved follow-ups to open-item-management rather than trying to handle them itself), and captures a concise outcome/learning rather than a full transcript.

evals.name: Wave 2 post-merge Notion learning capture (status-and-learning)
evals.prompt: Capture the outcome and learning in Notion now that Wave 2's merge-to-completion has merged the PR and closed Linear issue ENG-206.
evals.expected_output: Reads relevant Linear facts and the Issue's git-github-evidence array via linear-work-management (not linear-github-linking); produces a dated summary explicitly labeled as a snapshot, not live state; gets approval before the Notion write; never treats itself as a live GitHub automation endpoint.
